local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local timer=-1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<.2 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during earned ingredient use')
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 local lettuce=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x01ebff)
 local rice=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x33690)
 print('VilverinContinue ingredient sample count='..inv:countOf(lettuce)..' rice='..inv:countOf(rice)..' fatigue='..Actor.stats.dynamic.fatigue(self).current..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
end}}}}
